limits: Review is of the acquired arXiv v2, not the inaccessible full journal version.
Complete external proofs of all cited foundational results were not independently reproduced.
Only selected relevant dissertation pages were scientifically read; full 310-page extraction was mechanical.
Symbolic checks validate the displayed calculations; no blanket proof certificate.
No author code executed, no missing-code mathematical defect alleged.
Major grading is bounded to proved assertions and interpretation-specific counterexamples; no entire-paper failure asserted.
